notes: Visible roles are intentionally conservative for the standard floor variant. Biceps brachii was excluded because the direct standard-push-up evidence reviewed here reports very low activation in that variant. Rotator cuff and trunk muscles were not added because available direct evidence for this exact entry was indirect, not represented cleanly in the current shared anatomy, or better treated as technique limitations. Most included studies used small samples of healthy young adults, and EMG normalization, hand-width definitions, depth, cadence, fatigue, and relative body mass can shift results.
